TRACE-X SAMPLE EVIDENCE REPORT
Case ID: TX-104
Date: 12 October 2025

Investigation note:
On 12 October 2025, analyst Maya Raman met officer Daniel Joseph at the Central Records Office in Chennai.
They reviewed a shipment record linked to Orion Logistics. The record stated that a sealed package was sent from Chennai to Bengaluru on 10 October 2025.
A follow-up meeting was scheduled in Coimbatore on 15 October 2025.

Key details:
People: Maya Raman, Daniel Joseph
Organization: Orion Logistics
Locations: Chennai, Bengaluru, Coimbatore
Dates: 10 October 2025, 12 October 2025, 15 October 2025
